description:
You are a Senior Accountant (CPA) at Harrington & Associates, preparing year-end tax documentation for a client's brokerage account. The client needs FIFO cost basis tracking for multiple tax lots acquired across Q4 2023 and Q1 2024. You must create a new portfolio named 'Tax Lots 2024' in JStock and enter each lot separately with clearing fees.

**Buy Transactions** (broker fee $4.95, clearing fee $0.20 each):
- COST (Costco Wholesale): 10 shares at $638.22 on December 1, 2023 — comment: 'COST lot 1 Dec 2023'
- COST (Costco Wholesale): 8 shares at $715.40 on January 19, 2024 — comment: 'COST lot 2 Jan 2024'
- META (Meta Platforms): 20 shares at $367.15 on December 15, 2023 — comment: 'META lot 1 Dec 2023'
- META (Meta Platforms): 12 shares at $484.10 on January 26, 2024 — comment: 'META lot 2 Jan 2024'
- AMZN (Amazon.com): 30 shares at $172.35 on February 2, 2024 — comment: 'AMZN growth Feb 2024'

**Sell Transaction** (FIFO disposition of COST lot 1; broker fee $4.95):
- COST: Sell 10 shares at $755.60 on February 22, 2024 — comment: 'COST FIFO lot 1 realized'

**Watchlist Alerts** (create watchlist 'Tax Watch 2024', set 52-week range alerts):
- META: Fall Below $350.00, Rise Above $525.00
- AMZN: Fall Below $155.00, Rise Above $195.00

Note: Prices are from Yahoo Finance historical data. Clearing fees must be entered separately from broker commissions. The portfolio name 'Tax Lots 2024' and watchlist name 'Tax Watch 2024' must match exactly for automated tax software export.
